observations: White industrial sewing machine head mounted on a standard industrial table.
Brand 'EMEL' is visible in red oval logos on the front (photo 0) and side (photo 1) of the machine.
A double-spool thread stand is attached to the table.
An electric clutch motor and a power switch are visible under the table (photo 1).
A metal identification plate is located on the side of the machine pillar, but the text is unreadable (photo 1).
The table has a ruler printed along the front edge.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a heavy-duty machine head with an external motor and industrial table.
Photos show the exterior but cannot confirm the extent of internal mechanical wear.
Static photos cannot prove the motor or mechanical components function correctly.

risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and running.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical timing or gears may be damaged or seized.
risks.proof: A video of the machine sewing through a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: Essential small parts like the bobbin case or presser foot may be missing.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the needle and shuttle area.

proof_requests: Clear, close-up photo of the metal model plate on the side of the machine.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate the motor and stitch quality.
response.reason: The brand is identified as EMEL, but the specific model number on the side plate is unreadable. A video is also required to verify the seller's claim of excellent working condition.
